text:
Maya: Quick flag 306A84DD - after the latest Orbit ATS deploy some scorecards are saving with blank 'submitted_at' fields. Panels for EngInfra (cand-10234, cand-10298) show missing submitted timestamps so averages aren't including them.
Diego: Yikes. Is it only the timestamp or are whole submissions being dropped?
Maya: The UI shows them as saved, reviewers can open them and see scores, but backend shows submitted_at = null.
Renee: Could be a DB migration quirk or an event ordering race from the new inline notes feature. We shipped that on the same deploy.
Omar: I see a bunch of 409s in the event-processor logs around 09:12. Looks like duplicate write contention when notes are big.
Kai: For upcoming debriefs (12:30 & 1:00) we need deterministic averages. Quick manual: export all scorecards to CSV and compute averages excluding rows with submitted_at null? That would bias things.
Maya: Agreed not ideal. Temporary process I propose: 1) Ask interviewers to click 'Submit and finalize' again (it usually flips the flag). 2) If they already left, have them paste the final screenshot into candidate comments and DM the hiring manager. 3) I'll run a reconcile script that treats saved-but-unsubmitted cards as submitted if they have >3 non-empty score fields and a notes checksum match.
Diego: Can you share that script? We might want to run in dry-run first to see how many would be auto-marked.
Maya: Putting dry-run output into OPS-4899 now. Sample: cand-10234 had scores {tech:5, design:4, role-fit:4}, notes length 8kb, submitted_at null.
Renee: Also: we've been rolling out a rubric change — competency weights changed to (25/25/50). Some interviewers are still using pre-rollout PDF with 30/30/40. If we auto-mark older cards we could be mixing apples/oranges.
Omar: Good catch. Suggest tagging auto-marked cards with metadata "autocompleted_by:reconcile-v1" and recording which rubric version applied. That way hiring managers know which to include/exclude.
Kai: I'll brief hiring managers in 10 mins. Also, can we add a short required checkbox in the UI "I confirm I used rubric v2" before submit? That would prevent ambiguity.
Maya: Will add a feature request. For now, Pri-level workaround: require panel leads to confirm in debrief if any auto-marked cards should be excluded.
hiring-bot: New micro-training "ATS quick submit + rubric v2 checklist (15m, async)" published to #hiring-resources. RSVP optional. :bookmark_tabs:
Diego: Ops note: I've opened infra ticket INF-2021 to investigate the 409s. If the event-processor can't handle larger payloads we should increase retry window and queue backpressure.
Renee: After patch, let's run a sweep to add submitted_at for any cards where interviewer explicitly hit 'submit' (we can infer from client logs). We should also push a small client-side guard to prevent duplicate submits.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll coordinate the reconcile run and post a summary in this thread once the dry-run completes. Also scheduling a 20-min live demo tomorrow for new interviewers on the rubric and the submit flow.
Kai: Perfect. If reconcile marks anything questionable, let's add it to the candidate note instead of auto-including in averages.
Maya: Agreed. Filing post-incident checklist and owners in OPS-4899 (owner: Maya).
